protocol.judge_prompt: candidate-isolated v6 rationale-only Korean feedback-quality rubric; source-score blind; score-only JSON; five prompt emphases with ten seed repeats; throughput-tuned runtime only

axis_feedback_quality_rubric.content: Evaluate whether the rationale accurately and specifically explains the essay's ideas, relevance, adequacy, or development. Unsupported or overclaimed rationale receives a lower score.
axis_feedback_quality_rubric.organization: Evaluate whether the rationale accurately and specifically explains the essay's structure, sequence, paragraph linkage, coherence, or cohesion. Unsupported or overclaimed rationale receives a lower score.
axis_feedback_quality_rubric.expression: Evaluate whether the rationale accurately and specifically explains the essay's clarity, wording, grammar, sentence construction, or style. Unsupported or overclaimed rationale receives a lower score.

prompt_types.review_emphasis: Apply all stated rationale-quality criteria evenly. Use the full 1-to-5 scale; do not infer an external writing label.
Give special weight to whether each rationale is grounded in the essay and names a sufficiently specific strength or weakness; unsupported or generic rationale must receive a low score.
Penalize rationale that overclaims, understates, or misreads the essay. Calibrate its severity to what the text actually supports.
Give special weight to whether each rationale stays within content, organization, or expression rather than confusing the three axes.
Give special weight to clear, internally consistent, natural Korean rationale without repetition or vague filler; weak communication must receive a low score.

protocol.train_scoring: score observations only; may not use validation observations
protocol.validation_scoring: frozen evaluation-only; may not influence train selection, prompt choice, SFT, DPO, or GRPO
